import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

# ------------------------------ load data ------------------------------
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")
target = train["Transported"].copy()
train_id = train["PassengerId"]
test_id = test["PassengerId"]

# combine for safe feature engineering
all_data = pd.concat([train.drop(columns=["Transported"]), test], ignore_index=True)

# ------------------------------ base feature engineering ------------------------------
# Cabin -> deck, cabin_num, side
all_data["Cabin"] = all_data["Cabin"].fillna("U/0/U")
split = all_data["Cabin"].str.split("/", expand=True)
all_data["deck"] = split[0]
all_data["cabin_num"] = pd.to_numeric(split[1], errors="coerce")
all_data["side"] = split[2]

# PassengerId -> group_id, passenger_num
all_data["group_id"] = all_data["PassengerId"].apply(lambda x: x.split("_")[0])
all_data["passenger_num"] = all_data["PassengerId"].apply(
    lambda x: int(x.split("_")[1])
)

# group size
all_data["group_size"] = all_data.groupby("group_id")["group_id"].transform("count")

# Title extraction from Name
all_data["title"] = all_data["Name"].str.extract(r" ([A-Za-z]+)\.")
all_data["title"] = all_data["title"].fillna("NoTitle")
title_counts = all_data["title"].value_counts()
all_data["title"] = all_data["title"].apply(
    lambda t: t if title_counts[t] >= 10 else "Other"
)

# deck + side interaction
all_data["deck_side"] = all_data["deck"] + "_" + all_data["side"]

# Amenity spending totals and ratios
spending_cols = ["RoomService", "FoodCourt", "ShoppingMall", "Spa", "VRDeck"]
all_data["TotalSpending"] = all_data[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)
for col in spending_cols:
    all_data[f"{col}_ratio"] = np.where(
        all_data["TotalSpending"] > 0,
        all_data[col] / all_data["TotalSpending"],
        0.0,
    )
all_data["HasSpending"] = (all_data["TotalSpending"] > 0).astype(int)

# drop original identifiers and free text that we no longer need
drop_cols = ["PassengerId", "Cabin", "Name"]
all_data.drop(columns=drop_cols, inplace=True, errors="ignore")

# ------------------------------ imputation ------------------------------
numeric_cols = (
    [
        "Age",
        "RoomService",
        "FoodCourt",
        "ShoppingMall",
        "Spa",
        "VRDeck",
        "cabin_num",
        "passenger_num",
        "group_size",
        "TotalSpending",
    ]
    + [f"{col}_ratio" for col in spending_cols]
    + ["HasSpending"]
)

for col in numeric_cols:
    median_val = all_data[col].median()
    all_data[col].fillna(median_val, inplace=True)

# categorical columns (will be target-encoded later, but also used as categorical features)
cat_cols_str = [
    "HomePlanet",
    "CryoSleep",
    "Destination",
    "VIP",
    "deck",
    "side",
    "group_id",
    "title",
    "deck_side",
]

# fill missing with 'Unknown'
for col in cat_cols_str:
    all_data[col] = all_data[col].fillna("Unknown").astype(str)

# create integer code versions for LightGBM (map strings to ints)
cat_col_code = {col: col + "_code" for col in cat_cols_str}
for col in cat_cols_str:
    all_data[cat_col_code[col]], _ = pd.factorize(all_data[col])

# ------------------------------ split back ------------------------------
base_train = all_data.iloc[: len(train)].reset_index(drop=True)
base_test = all_data.iloc[len(train) :].reset_index(drop=True)

# X_base_train (features only) – no target column exists, so direct copy
X_base_train = base_train.copy()
y_base = train["Transported"]  # boolean target

# list of all feature columns (including code cols) that we can input to LightGBM
feature_cols = numeric_cols + list(cat_col_code.values())

# list of categorical feature names for LightGBM (the integer code columns)
lgb_cat_cols = list(cat_col_code.values())


# ------------------------------ target encoding helper ------------------------------
def add_target_encoding(train_df, val_df, target_series, cat_cols, prior=5.0):
    """
    train_df : DataFrame with original features (contains only training rows)
    val_df   : DataFrame with same columns (validation or test rows)
    target_series : Series with target for train_df, aligned with train_df index
    cat_cols : list of column names (string) to encode
    prior    : smoothing parameter
    Returns (train_df, val_df) with new '_te' columns added.
    """
    target_name = target_series.name
    train_temp = train_df.copy()
    train_temp[target_name] = target_series.values

    global_mean = train_temp[target_name].mean()

    for col in cat_cols:
        stats = train_temp.groupby(col)[target_name].agg(["sum", "count"])
        stats["smooth"] = (stats["sum"] + prior * global_mean) / (
            stats["count"] + prior
        )
        mapping = stats["smooth"].to_dict()

        train_df[f"{col}_te"] = train_df[col].map(mapping).fillna(global_mean)
        val_df[f"{col}_te"] = val_df[col].map(mapping).fillna(global_mean)

    return train_df, val_df


# ------------------------------ 5-fold CV with out-of-fold target encoding ------------------------------
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "binary_error",
    "boosting": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "random_state": 42,
    "verbose": -1,
}

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
accuracies = []
best_iters = []

for fold, (tr_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_base_train, y_base)):
    # split raw data
    X_tr_raw = X_base_train.iloc[tr_idx].copy()
    X_val_raw = X_base_train.iloc[val_idx].copy()
    y_tr = y_base.iloc[tr_idx].copy()
    y_val = y_base.iloc[val_idx].copy()

    # out-of-fold target encoding
    X_tr_enc, X_val_enc = add_target_encoding(
        X_tr_raw, X_val_raw, y_tr, cat_cols_str, prior=5.0
    )

    # remove the string categorical columns (only keep code + new TE)
    X_tr_model = X_tr_enc.drop(columns=cat_cols_str)
    X_val_model = X_val_enc.drop(columns=cat_cols_str)

    dtrain = lgb.Dataset(X_tr_model, label=y_tr, categorical_feature=lgb_cat_cols)
    dval = lgb.Dataset(
        X_val_model, label=y_val, categorical_feature=lgb_cat_cols, reference=dtrain
    )

    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        dtrain,
        num_boost_round=1000,
        valid_sets=[dval],
        callbacks=[
            lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50),
            lgb.log_evaluation(100),
        ],
    )

    best_iters.append(model.best_iteration)
    preds = (
        model.predict(X_val_model, num_iteration=model.best_iteration) > 0.5
    ).astype(bool)
    acc = accuracy_score(y_val, preds)
    accuracies.append(acc)

mean_acc = np.mean(accuracies)
mean_best_iter = int(np.mean(best_iters))

# ------------------------------ final target encoding on full train ------------------------------
X_full_raw = X_base_train.copy()
y_full = y_base.copy()

X_test_raw = base_test.copy()  # base_test already has all columns (no target)
X_full_enc, X_test_enc = add_target_encoding(
    X_full_raw, X_test_raw, y_full, cat_cols_str, prior=5.0
)

# drop string columns
X_full_model = X_full_enc.drop(columns=cat_cols_str)
X_test_model = X_test_enc.drop(columns=cat_cols_str)

# ------------------------------ final model ------------------------------
dtrain_full = lgb.Dataset(X_full_model, label=y_full, categorical_feature=lgb_cat_cols)
final_model = lgb.train(
    params,
    dtrain_full,
    num_boost_round=mean_best_iter,
    valid_sets=[dtrain_full],
    callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(100)],
)

test_proba = final_model.predict(X_test_model, num_iteration=mean_best_iter)
test_preds = test_proba > 0.5

# ------------------------------ submission ------------------------------
sub = pd.read_csv("./data/sample_submission.csv")
sub["Transported"] = np.where(test_preds, "True", "False")
sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

# ------------------------------ final output ------------------------------
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {mean_acc:.4f}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, RandomizedSearchCV
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

# ======================== load data ========================
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./data/sample_submission.csv")

train_target = train["Transported"].astype(int).copy()
train_no_target = train.drop(columns=["Transported"])

# ======================== feature engineering (combined, no target) ========================
all_data = pd.concat([train_no_target, test], ignore_index=True)

# cabin splitting
all_data["Cabin"] = all_data["Cabin"].fillna("U/0/U")
split = all_data["Cabin"].str.split("/", expand=True)
all_data["deck"] = split[0]
all_data["cabin_num"] = pd.to_numeric(split[1], errors="coerce")
all_data["side"] = split[2]
all_data["Cabin_raw"] = all_data["Cabin"].astype(str)  # for target encoding

# passenger id -> group
all_data["group_id_raw"] = all_data["PassengerId"].apply(lambda x: x.split("_")[0])
all_data["passenger_num"] = all_data["PassengerId"].apply(
    lambda x: int(x.split("_")[1])
)
all_data["group_size"] = all_data.groupby("group_id_raw")["group_id_raw"].transform(
    "count"
)

# ----- boolean columns BEFORE factorization (needed for group ratios) -----
all_data["CryoSleep_bool"] = (
    all_data["CryoSleep"].fillna("Unknown").str.lower() == "true"
).astype(int)
all_data["VIP_bool"] = (all_data["VIP"].fillna("Unknown").str.lower() == "true").astype(
    int
)

# group cryosleep / VIP ratios
all_data["group_cryo_ratio"] = all_data.groupby("group_id_raw")[
    "CryoSleep_bool"
].transform("mean")
all_data["group_vip_ratio"] = all_data.groupby("group_id_raw")["VIP_bool"].transform(
    "mean"
)
all_data.drop(columns=["CryoSleep_bool", "VIP_bool"], inplace=True)

# low-cardinality categoricals -> factorize (now CryoSleep and VIP are still strings)
cat_cols = ["HomePlanet", "CryoSleep", "Destination", "VIP", "deck", "side"]
for col in cat_cols:
    all_data[col] = all_data[col].fillna("Unknown").astype(str)
    all_data[col], _ = pd.factorize(all_data[col])

# numeric spending columns (keep NaN for LightGBM's native handling)
spending_cols = ["RoomService", "FoodCourt", "ShoppingMall", "Spa", "VRDeck"]
for sp in spending_cols:
    all_data[sp] = pd.to_numeric(all_data[sp], errors="coerce")
    all_data[f"group_total_{sp}"] = all_data.groupby("group_id_raw")[sp].transform(
        "sum"
    )

# Age
all_data["Age"] = pd.to_numeric(all_data["Age"], errors="coerce")
all_data["group_mean_Age"] = all_data.groupby("group_id_raw")["Age"].transform("mean")

# drop identifiers / free text
all_data.drop(columns=["Name", "PassengerId"], inplace=True)

# split back
train_len = len(train)
train_features = all_data.iloc[:train_len].reset_index(drop=True)
test_features = all_data.iloc[train_len:].reset_index(drop=True)
train_target = train_target.reset_index(drop=True)

# drop the raw 'Cabin' column – we already have deck/cabin_num/side and Cabin_raw for encoding
train_features.drop(columns=["Cabin"], inplace=True)
test_features.drop(columns=["Cabin"], inplace=True)

target_encode_cols = ["Cabin_raw", "group_id_raw"]

# ======================== outer 5-fold CV with nested target encoding & tuning ========================
outer_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
accuracies = []

param_dist = {
    "n_estimators": [100, 200, 300, 400, 500],
    "max_depth": [3, 4, 5, 6, 7, -1],
    "num_leaves": [15, 31, 63, 127],
    "min_child_samples": [5, 10, 20, 30, 50],
    "learning_rate": [0.01, 0.03, 0.05, 0.1],
    "subsample": [0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0],
    "colsample_bytree": [0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0],
    "reg_alpha": [0, 1e-3, 0.01, 0.1],
    "reg_lambda": [0, 1e-3, 0.01, 0.1],
}

for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(outer_skf.split(train_features, train_target)):
    print(f"Outer fold {fold+1}/5 ...")
    X_train_raw_fold = train_features.iloc[tr_idx].copy()
    X_val_raw_fold = train_features.iloc[va_idx].copy()
    y_train_fold = train_target.iloc[tr_idx].copy()
    y_val_fold = train_target.iloc[va_idx].copy()

    # --- target encoding within this outer fold ---
    def target_encode_outer(train_df, train_y, val_df, cols, smoothing=20):
        inner_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=fold + 100)
        global_mean = float(train_y.mean())
        train_enc = pd.DataFrame(index=train_df.index)
        val_enc = pd.DataFrame(index=val_df.index)

        for col in cols:
            train_enc[col] = np.nan
            # out-of-fold encoding for the training part
            for itr, iva in inner_skf.split(train_df, train_y):
                tr_inner = train_df[col].iloc[itr]
                yi_inner = train_y.iloc[itr]
                grp = yi_inner.groupby(tr_inner)
                stats = grp.agg(count="count", sum="sum")
                stats["mean"] = stats["sum"] / stats["count"]
                stats["smoothed"] = (
                    stats["count"] * stats["mean"] + smoothing * global_mean
                ) / (stats["count"] + smoothing)
                # FIX: map validation fold's column values, not training fold's
                train_enc.iloc[iva, train_enc.columns.get_loc(col)] = (
                    train_df[col]
                    .iloc[iva]
                    .map(stats["smoothed"])
                    .fillna(global_mean)
                    .values
                )
            # encode the validation fold using all training data
            full_grp = train_y.groupby(train_df[col])
            full_stats = full_grp.agg(count="count", sum="sum")
            full_stats["mean"] = full_stats["sum"] / full_stats["count"]
            full_stats["smoothed"] = (
                full_stats["count"] * full_stats["mean"] + smoothing * global_mean
            ) / (full_stats["count"] + smoothing)
            val_enc[col] = (
                val_df[col].map(full_stats["smoothed"]).fillna(global_mean).values
            )
        return train_enc, val_enc

    train_enc, val_enc = target_encode_outer(
        X_train_raw_fold, y_train_fold, X_val_raw_fold, target_encode_cols, smoothing=20
    )

    # build final numeric feature matrices for this fold
    X_train_fold = pd.concat(
        [
            X_train_raw_fold.drop(columns=target_encode_cols).reset_index(drop=True),
            train_enc.reset_index(drop=True),
        ],
        axis=1,
    )
    X_val_fold = pd.concat(
        [
            X_val_raw_fold.drop(columns=target_encode_cols).reset_index(drop=True),
            val_enc.reset_index(drop=True),
        ],
        axis=1,
    )

    # --- hyperparameter tuning on the training fold ---
    lgb_tuner = RandomizedSearchCV(
        lgb.LGBMClassifier(
            objective="binary", random_state=42, verbose=-1, force_row_wise=True
        ),
        param_dist,
        n_iter=15,
        cv=3,
        scoring="accuracy",
        random_state=fold,
        verbose=0,
        n_jobs=1,
    )
    lgb_tuner.fit(X_train_fold, y_train_fold)
    best_params = lgb_tuner.best_params_

    # train final fold model
    fold_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        **best_params, objective="binary", random_state=42, verbose=-1
    )
    fold_model.fit(X_train_fold, y_train_fold)
    y_pred_fold = fold_model.predict(X_val_fold)
    accuracies.append(accuracy_score(y_val_fold, y_pred_fold))

outer_cv_score = np.mean(accuracies)
print(f"Outer 5-fold CV accuracy: {outer_cv_score:.4f}")

# ======================== final model on full training data ========================
# target encoding on full train (out-of-fold) and test encoding from full train
inner_skf_final = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
global_mean = float(train_target.mean())
train_enc_final = pd.DataFrame(index=train_features.index)
test_enc_final = pd.DataFrame(index=test_features.index)

for col in target_encode_cols:
    train_enc_final[col] = np.nan
    for tr_idx, va_idx in inner_skf_final.split(train_features, train_target):
        tr_inner = train_features[col].iloc[tr_idx]
        yi_inner = train_target.iloc[tr_idx]
        grp = yi_inner.groupby(tr_inner)
        stats = grp.agg(count="count", sum="sum")
        stats["mean"] = stats["sum"] / stats["count"]
        stats["smoothed"] = (stats["count"] * stats["mean"] + 20 * global_mean) / (
            stats["count"] + 20
        )
        # FIX: map validation fold's column values
        train_enc_final.iloc[va_idx, train_enc_final.columns.get_loc(col)] = (
            train_features[col]
            .iloc[va_idx]
            .map(stats["smoothed"])
            .fillna(global_mean)
            .values
        )
    # test encoding from full training data
    full_grp = train_target.groupby(train_features[col])
    full_stats = full_grp.agg(count="count", sum="sum")
    full_stats["mean"] = full_stats["sum"] / full_stats["count"]
    full_stats["smoothed"] = (
        full_stats["count"] * full_stats["mean"] + 20 * global_mean
    ) / (full_stats["count"] + 20)
    test_enc_final[col] = (
        test_features[col].map(full_stats["smoothed"]).fillna(global_mean).values
    )

X_train_final = pd.concat(
    [
        train_features.drop(columns=target_encode_cols).reset_index(drop=True),
        train_enc_final.reset_index(drop=True),
    ],
    axis=1,
)
X_test_final = pd.concat(
    [
        test_features.drop(columns=target_encode_cols).reset_index(drop=True),
        test_enc_final.reset_index(drop=True),
    ],
    axis=1,
)

# hyperparameter search on full training set
lgb_final_tuner = RandomizedSearchCV(
    lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        objective="binary", random_state=42, verbose=-1, force_row_wise=True
    ),
    param_dist,
    n_iter=20,
    cv=5,
    scoring="accuracy",
    random_state=0,
    verbose=0,
    n_jobs=1,
)
lgb_final_tuner.fit(X_train_final, train_target)
best_params_final = lgb_final_tuner.best_params_

# train final model on full training set
final_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    **best_params_final, objective="binary", random_state=42, verbose=-1
)
final_model.fit(X_train_final, train_target)

# predict test
test_preds = final_model.predict(X_test_final).astype(bool)

# ======================== submission ========================
sub = sample_sub.copy()
sub["Transported"] = np.where(test_preds, "True", "False")
sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

# ======================== final output ========================
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {outer_cv_score:.4f}")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from bayes_opt import BayesianOptimization
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ==============================================
# 1. Load data
# ==============================================
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")
test_ids = test["PassengerId"]
target = train["Transported"].copy()

all_data = pd.concat([train.drop(columns=["Transported"]), test], ignore_index=True)

# ==============================================
# 2. Feature engineering (no target usage)
# ==============================================
# --- Cabin -> deck, cabin_num, side (keep NaN) ---
split = all_data["Cabin"].str.split("/", expand=True)
all_data["deck"] = split[0]
all_data["cabin_num"] = pd.to_numeric(split[1], errors="coerce")
all_data["side"] = split[2]

# --- PassengerId -> group_id, passenger_num ---
all_data["group_id"] = all_data["PassengerId"].apply(lambda x: x.split("_")[0])
all_data["passenger_num"] = all_data["PassengerId"].apply(
    lambda x: int(x.split("_")[1])
)

# --- group size ---
all_data["group_size"] = all_data.groupby("group_id")["group_id"].transform("count")

# Drop identifiers / free text
all_data.drop(columns=["PassengerId", "Cabin", "Name"], inplace=True, errors="ignore")

# ==============================================
# 3. Convert categoricals to `category` dtype (NA stays)
# ==============================================
cat_cols = [
    "HomePlanet",
    "CryoSleep",
    "Destination",
    "VIP",
    "deck",
    "side",
    "group_id",
]
for col in cat_cols:
    all_data[col] = all_data[col].astype("category")

# ==============================================
# 4. Numeric missing indicators (no imputation)
# ==============================================
numeric_cols = [
    "Age",
    "RoomService",
    "FoodCourt",
    "ShoppingMall",
    "Spa",
    "VRDeck",
    "cabin_num",
    "passenger_num",
    "group_size",
]
for col in numeric_cols:
    all_data[col + "_missing"] = all_data[col].isna().astype(int)

# ==============================================
# 5. Split back to train / test
# ==============================================
train_feat = all_data.iloc[: len(train)].reset_index(drop=True)
test_feat = all_data.iloc[len(train) :].reset_index(drop=True)

# ==============================================
# 6. 5-fold split (fixed for CV & tuning)
# ==============================================
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
folds = list(skf.split(train_feat, target))


# ==============================================
# 7. Cross-validation helper
# ==============================================
def cross_val(params, X, y, folds, n_rounds=1000, early_stop=50):
    accs = []
    iters = []
    for tr_idx, va_idx in folds:
        X_tr, X_val = X.iloc[tr_idx], X.iloc[va_idx]
        y_tr, y_val = y.iloc[tr_idx], y.iloc[va_idx]

        dtrain = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr, categorical_feature="auto")
        dval = lgb.Dataset(
            X_val, label=y_val, categorical_feature="auto", reference=dtrain
        )

        model = lgb.train(
            params,
            dtrain,
            num_boost_round=n_rounds,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(early_stop), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        preds = (model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration) > 0.5).astype(
            int
        )
        acc = accuracy_score(y_val, preds)
        accs.append(acc)
        iters.append(model.best_iteration)
    return np.mean(accs), np.mean(iters)


# ==============================================
# 8. Bayesian Optimization setup
# ==============================================
pbounds = {
    "learning_rate": (0.01, 0.2),
    "num_leaves": (15, 127),
    "min_data_in_leaf": (10, 100),
    "bagging_fraction": (0.5, 1.0),
    "feature_fraction": (0.5, 1.0),
    "lambda_l1": (0.0, 10.0),
    "lambda_l2": (0.0, 10.0),
}


def objective(
    learning_rate,
    num_leaves,
    min_data_in_leaf,
    bagging_fraction,
    feature_fraction,
    lambda_l1,
    lambda_l2,
):
    p = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "binary_error",
        "boosting": "gbdt",
        "learning_rate": learning_rate,
        "num_leaves": int(num_leaves),
        "min_data_in_leaf": int(min_data_in_leaf),
        "bagging_fraction": bagging_fraction,
        "bagging_freq": 1,
        "feature_fraction": feature_fraction,
        "lambda_l1": lambda_l1,
        "lambda_l2": lambda_l2,
        "seed": 42,
        "verbose": -1,
        "force_row_wise": True,
    }
    mean_acc, _ = cross_val(p, train_feat, target, folds, n_rounds=1000, early_stop=50)
    return mean_acc


optimizer = BayesianOptimization(
    f=objective,
    pbounds=pbounds,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=0,
)

# ==============================================
# 9. Run hyperparameter search
# ==============================================
optimizer.maximize(init_points=5, n_iter=10)  # 15 total iterations

best_params = optimizer.max["params"]
# Convert integer parameters
best_params["num_leaves"] = int(best_params["num_leaves"])
best_params["min_data_in_leaf"] = int(best_params["min_data_in_leaf"])

# ==============================================
# 10. Final 5-fold CV with best parameters
# ==============================================
final_params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "binary_error",
    "boosting": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": best_params["learning_rate"],
    "num_leaves": best_params["num_leaves"],
    "min_data_in_leaf": best_params["min_data_in_leaf"],
    "bagging_fraction": best_params["bagging_fraction"],
    "bagging_freq": 1,
    "feature_fraction": best_params["feature_fraction"],
    "lambda_l1": best_params["lambda_l1"],
    "lambda_l2": best_params["lambda_l2"],
    "seed": 42,
    "verbose": -1,
    "force_row_wise": True,
}

final_acc, final_best_iter = cross_val(
    final_params, train_feat, target, folds, n_rounds=1000, early_stop=50
)

# ==============================================
# 11. Train final model on all training data
# ==============================================
dtrain_full = lgb.Dataset(train_feat, label=target, categorical_feature="auto")
final_model = lgb.train(
    final_params,
    dtrain_full,
    num_boost_round=int(np.ceil(final_best_iter)),
    valid_sets=[dtrain_full],
    callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
)

# ==============================================
# 12. Predict test set and create submission
# ==============================================
test_proba = final_model.predict(test_feat, num_iteration=int(np.ceil(final_best_iter)))
test_preds = test_proba > 0.5

sub = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "PassengerId": test_ids,
        "Transported": np.where(test_preds, "True", "False"),
    }
)
sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

# ==============================================
# 13. Final output
# ==============================================
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {final_acc:.4f}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Spaceship Titanic – Pseudo‑labeling + Optuna‑tuned LightGBM with group features.
(Fixed AttributeError + category dtype safeguarding)
"""

import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, train_test_split
import optuna
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# --------------------------- 1. Load data ---------------------------
train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")

n_train = len(train)

# Keep PassengerId for submission
test_ids = test["PassengerId"].copy()

# Mark origin
train["_is_train"] = 1
test["_is_train"] = 0

# Drop target from train for combined processing
train_no_target = train.drop(columns=["Transported"])

combined = pd.concat([train_no_target, test], axis=0, ignore_index=True)

# --------------------------- 2. Feature engineering ---------------------------
# PassengerId
combined[["GroupId", "PassengerNum"]] = combined["PassengerId"].str.split(
    "_", expand=True
)
combined["PassengerNum"] = combined["PassengerNum"].astype(float)

# Cabin
cabin_split = combined["Cabin"].str.split("/", n=2, expand=True)
cabin_split.columns = ["Deck", "CabinNum", "Side"]
cabin_split["CabinNum"] = pd.to_numeric(cabin_split["CabinNum"], errors="coerce")
combined["Deck"] = cabin_split["Deck"]
combined["CabinNum"] = cabin_split["CabinNum"]
combined["Side"] = cabin_split["Side"]

# Name -> LastName
combined["LastName"] = combined["Name"].str.split().str[-1]

# Drop raw columns
combined.drop(columns=["PassengerId", "Name", "Cabin"], inplace=True)

# ---------- 2a. Imputation (on combined) ----------
# Numeric columns (including PassengerNum, CabinNum)
num_cols = [
    "Age",
    "RoomService",
    "FoodCourt",
    "ShoppingMall",
    "Spa",
    "VRDeck",
    "PassengerNum",
    "CabinNum",
]
for c in num_cols:
    med = combined[c].median()
    combined[c].fillna(med, inplace=True)

# Categorical / Boolean columns
for bool_col in ["CryoSleep", "VIP"]:
    # Robust mapping: handle both boolean and string True/False
    combined[bool_col] = combined[bool_col].replace(
        {True: 1, False: 0, "True": 1, "False": 0}
    )
    # Compute mode (if empty, fallback to 0)
    modes = combined[bool_col].mode()
    if len(modes) == 0:
        fill_val = 0
    else:
        fill_val = modes.iloc[0]
    combined[bool_col].fillna(fill_val, inplace=True)
    combined[bool_col] = combined[bool_col].astype(int)

# Other categorical columns
cat_cols = ["HomePlanet", "Destination", "Deck", "Side", "LastName", "GroupId"]
for c in cat_cols:
    combined[c] = combined[c].astype(str).str.strip()
    combined[c] = combined[c].replace(["", "nan", "None"], "Unknown")
    combined[c] = combined[c].fillna("Unknown")

# ---------- 2b. Group-level aggregations ----------
agg_cols = [
    "Age",
    "RoomService",
    "FoodCourt",
    "ShoppingMall",
    "Spa",
    "VRDeck",
    "PassengerNum",
    "VIP",
    "CryoSleep",
]

group_stats = (
    combined.groupby("GroupId")[agg_cols]
    .agg(["mean", "std", "min", "max"])
    .reset_index()
)

# Flatten column names
group_stats.columns = ["GroupId"] + [
    f"Grp_{col}_{stat}" for col in agg_cols for stat in ["mean", "std", "min", "max"]
]

# Add group size
group_size = combined.groupby("GroupId").size().reset_index(name="Grp_Size")
group_stats = group_stats.merge(group_size, on="GroupId", how="left")

# Merge back
combined = combined.merge(group_stats, on="GroupId", how="left")

# ---------- 2c. Separate train / test ----------
train_processed = combined.iloc[:n_train].copy()
test_processed = combined.iloc[n_train:].copy()

# Restore target
y = train["Transported"].map({"True": 1, "False": 0}).values.astype(int)

# Drop temporary columns
drop_cols = ["_is_train"]
X = train_processed.drop(columns=drop_cols)
X_test = test_processed.drop(columns=drop_cols)

# Ensure consistent column order
feature_names = X.columns.tolist()
X_test = X_test[feature_names]

# Convert categorical columns to pandas 'category' dtype (LightGBM handles them)
cat_features = [c for c in X.columns if X[c].dtype == "object"]
for c in cat_features:
    X[c] = X[c].astype("category")
    X_test[c] = X_test[c].astype("category")


# --------------------------- 3. Optuna hyperparameter tuning ---------------------------
def objective(trial):
    params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "binary_error",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "verbosity": -1,
        "n_jobs": -1,
        "seed": 42,
        "learning_rate": trial.suggest_float("learning_rate", 0.01, 0.1, log=True),
        "num_leaves": trial.suggest_int("num_leaves", 16, 127),
        "max_depth": trial.suggest_int("max_depth", 5, 15),
        "min_child_samples": trial.suggest_int("min_child_samples", 10, 50),
        "feature_fraction": trial.suggest_float("feature_fraction", 0.5, 1.0),
        "bagging_fraction": trial.suggest_float("bagging_fraction", 0.5, 1.0),
        "bagging_freq": trial.suggest_int("bagging_freq", 1, 7),
        "lambda_l1": trial.suggest_float("lambda_l1", 1e-8, 10.0, log=True),
        "lambda_l2": trial.suggest_float("lambda_l2", 1e-8, 10.0, log=True),
    }

    dtrain = lgb.Dataset(X, label=y, categorical_feature=cat_features)

    cv_results = lgb.cv(
        params,
        dtrain,
        nfold=5,
        stratified=True,
        num_boost_round=500,
        callbacks=[
            lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50),
            lgb.log_evaluation(0),
        ],
        seed=42,
    )

    best_error = min(cv_results["valid binary_error-mean"])
    accuracy = 1.0 - best_error
    return accuracy


study = optuna.create_study(
    direction="maximize", sampler=optuna.samplers.TPESampler(seed=42)
)
study.optimize(objective, n_trials=50, timeout=1800)

best_params = study.best_params
best_params.update(
    {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "binary_error",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "verbosity": -1,
        "n_jobs": -1,
        "seed": 42,
    }
)

print(f"Best hyperparameters: {best_params}")

# --------------------------- 4. Compute CV accuracy with best params ---------------------------
dtrain_final = lgb.Dataset(X, label=y, categorical_feature=cat_features)
cv_final = lgb.cv(
    best_params,
    dtrain_final,
    nfold=5,
    stratified=True,
    num_boost_round=500,
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
    seed=42,
)
best_error_final = min(cv_final["valid binary_error-mean"])
cv_accuracy = 1.0 - best_error_final

# --------------------------- 5. Self‑training with pseudo‑labels ---------------------------
# 5a. Train first model on 90% with early stopping
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.1, stratify=y, random_state=42
)
dtrain_full = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr, categorical_feature=cat_features)
dval_full = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val, label=y_val, categorical_feature=cat_features, reference=dtrain_full
)

model1 = lgb.train(
    best_params,
    dtrain_full,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[dval_full],
    valid_names=["valid"],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
)

# 5b. Predict on test
proba_test = model1.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model1.best_iteration)

# 5c. Pseudo‑labels (confident predictions only)
threshold = 0.95
pseudo_mask = (proba_test > threshold) | (proba_test < (1 - threshold))
pseudo_labels = (proba_test >= 0.5).astype(int)  # numpy array
pseudo_labels = pseudo_labels[pseudo_mask]  # still numpy array

X_pseudo = X_test.loc[pseudo_mask].copy()
y_pseudo = pseudo_labels  # *** FIX: already a numpy array ***

# Combine
X_aug = pd.concat([X, X_pseudo], axis=0, ignore_index=True)
y_aug = np.concatenate([y, y_pseudo], axis=0)

# Safeguard: re‑apply category dtype after concatenation
for c in cat_features:
    X_aug[c] = X_aug[c].astype("category")

# 5d. Second model on augmented data
X_tr_aug, X_val_aug, y_tr_aug, y_val_aug = train_test_split(
    X_aug, y_aug, test_size=0.1, stratify=y_aug, random_state=42
)
dtrain_aug = lgb.Dataset(X_tr_aug, label=y_tr_aug, categorical_feature=cat_features)
dval_aug = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val_aug, label=y_val_aug, categorical_feature=cat_features, reference=dtrain_aug
)

model2 = lgb.train(
    best_params,
    dtrain_aug,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[dval_aug],
    valid_names=["valid"],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
)

# 5e. Final test predictions
final_proba = model2.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model2.best_iteration)
final_pred = (final_proba >= 0.5).astype(int)

# --------------------------- 6. Submission ---------------------------
submission = pd.DataFrame({"PassengerId": test_ids, "Transported": final_pred})
submission["Transported"] = submission["Transported"].map({1: "True", 0: "False"})
submission.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

# --------------------------- 7. Final score ---------------------------
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {cv_accuracy:.4f}")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import os

# ========== 1. Load data ==========
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")

# Save test PassengerId for submission
test_passenger_ids = test["PassengerId"]

# Combine for feature engineering (excluding target)
target = train["Transported"].copy()
train_id = train["PassengerId"].copy()
test_id = test["PassengerId"].copy()

# Mark source
train["is_train"] = 1
test["is_train"] = 0
df = pd.concat([train.drop(columns=["Transported"]), test], axis=0, ignore_index=True)

# ========== 2. Split PassengerId ==========
df[["GroupId", "PassengerNum"]] = df["PassengerId"].str.split("_", expand=True)
df["PassengerNum"] = df["PassengerNum"].astype(int)
df["GroupId"] = df["GroupId"].astype(str)


# ========== 3. Split Cabin ==========
def split_cabin(cabin):
    if pd.isna(cabin) or cabin == "":
        return "UNK", -1, "UNK"
    # Take the first cabin if multiple (split by space)
    parts = cabin.split()
    first = parts[0]
    decomp = first.split("/")
    if len(decomp) == 3:
        deck, num, side = decomp
        try:
            num = int(num)
        except:
            num = -1
        if side not in ["P", "S"]:
            side = "UNK"
    else:
        deck, num, side = "UNK", -1, "UNK"
    return deck, num, side


cabin_decomposed = df["Cabin"].apply(split_cabin)
df["Deck"] = [x[0] for x in cabin_decomposed]
df["CabinNum"] = [x[1] for x in cabin_decomposed]
df["Side"] = [x[2] for x in cabin_decomposed]


# ========== 4. Parse Name -> LastName ==========
def extract_lastname(name):
    if pd.isna(name) or name == "":
        return "UNKNOWN"
    parts = name.strip().split()
    return parts[-1] if len(parts) > 0 else "UNKNOWN"


df["LastName"] = df["Name"].apply(extract_lastname)

# ========== 5. Unsupervised group/surname features ==========
# Group size (number of passengers with same GroupId)
group_size = df.groupby("GroupId")["PassengerId"].transform("count")
df["GroupSize"] = group_size

# Surname frequency
surname_count = df.groupby("LastName")["PassengerId"].transform("count")
df["SurnameCount"] = surname_count

# ========== 6. Fill missing values ==========
# Numeric columns: fill with median computed on training part
numeric_cols = [
    "Age",
    "RoomService",
    "FoodCourt",
    "ShoppingMall",
    "Spa",
    "VRDeck",
    "CabinNum",
]
train_mask = df["is_train"] == 1
for col in numeric_cols:
    median_val = df.loc[train_mask, col].median()
    df[col].fillna(median_val, inplace=True)

# Categorical columns: fill with 'UNK'
cat_cols = ["HomePlanet", "CryoSleep", "Destination", "VIP", "Deck", "Side"]
for col in cat_cols:
    df[col] = df[col].fillna("UNK").astype(str)

# Also fill CryoSleep and VIP as strings (they have True/False/NaN)
df["CryoSleep"] = df["CryoSleep"].replace(
    {"True": "True", "False": "False", "UNK": "UNK"}
)
df["VIP"] = df["VIP"].replace({"True": "True", "False": "False", "UNK": "UNK"})

# Convert boolean-like columns to string (already done)
# ========== 7. Convert categoricals to 'category' dtype ==========
final_cat_cols = [
    "HomePlanet",
    "CryoSleep",
    "Destination",
    "VIP",
    "Deck",
    "Side",
    "GroupId",
    "LastName",
]
for col in final_cat_cols:
    df[col] = df[col].astype("category")

# ========== 8. Separate back into train / test ==========
train_df = df[df["is_train"] == 1].drop(columns=["is_train"]).copy()
test_df = df[df["is_train"] == 0].drop(columns=["is_train"]).copy()

# ========== 9. Define feature list ==========
feature_cols = [
    "HomePlanet",
    "CryoSleep",
    "Destination",
    "VIP",
    "Age",
    "RoomService",
    "FoodCourt",
    "ShoppingMall",
    "Spa",
    "VRDeck",
    "PassengerNum",
    "Deck",
    "CabinNum",
    "Side",
    "GroupId",
    "GroupSize",
    "LastName",
    "SurnameCount",
]

X = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y = target.astype(int)  # True=1, False=0

# ========== 10. 5-fold Cross Validation ==========
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
accuracies = []
best_iterations = []

# LightGBM parameters
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "binary_logloss",
    "boosting": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "random_state": 42,
    "verbosity": -1,
    "force_col_wise": True,
    "num_threads": 4,  # limit threads for reproducibility
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "max_depth": -1,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
    "lambda_l1": 0.5,
    "lambda_l2": 0.5,
}

print("Starting 5-fold cross-validation...")
fold = 1
for train_idx, valid_idx in skf.split(X, y):
    X_train, X_valid = X.iloc[train_idx], X.iloc[valid_idx]
    y_train, y_valid = y.iloc[train_idx], y.iloc[valid_idx]

    # Further split training fold into train_ and val_ for early stopping (10%)
    X_tr, X_es, y_tr, y_es = train_test_split(
        X_train, y_train, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
    )

    # Create LightGBM dataset
    dtrain = lgb.Dataset(
        X_tr, label=y_tr, categorical_feature=final_cat_cols, free_raw_data=False
    )
    dvalid = lgb.Dataset(
        X_es, label=y_es, categorical_feature=final_cat_cols, free_raw_data=False
    )

    callbacks = [
        lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False),
        lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
    ]

    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        dtrain,
        valid_sets=[dvalid],
        callbacks=callbacks,
        num_boost_round=2000,
    )

    # Predict on validation fold
    preds_prob = model.predict(X_valid, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
    preds = (preds_prob > 0.5).astype(int)
    acc = accuracy_score(y_valid, preds)
    accuracies.append(acc)
    best_iterations.append(model.best_iteration)

    print(f"Fold {fold} accuracy: {acc:.6f}, best_iter: {model.best_iteration}")
    fold += 1

mean_acc = np.mean(accuracies)
std_acc = np.std(accuracies)
print(f"5-fold CV mean accuracy: {mean_acc:.6f} (±{std_acc:.6f})")

# ========== 11. Final model on full training set ==========
print("Training final model on full training data...")
# Hold-out 10% of training for early stopping
X_full_tr, X_full_val, y_full_tr, y_full_val = train_test_split(

# ========== 12. Predict on test set ==========

test_preds = (test_preds_prob > 0.5).astype(int)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
from lightgbm import early_stopping
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
from torch.optim import AdamW
import sys
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load data
# -------------------------------------------------------------
train_raw = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test_raw = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")

# Combine for consistent preprocessing
train_raw["is_train"] = 1
test_raw["is_train"] = 0
df = pd.concat([train_raw, test_raw], ignore_index=True)

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Feature engineering
# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Group ID from PassengerId
df["GroupId"] = df["PassengerId"].str.split("_").str[0]

# Cabin decomposition
df["Deck"] = df["Cabin"].str[0]  # first character
df["Num"] = df["Cabin"].str.split("/").str[1].astype(float)
df["Side"] = df["Cabin"].str.split("/").str[2]  # P or S
df["HasCabin"] = df["Cabin"].notna().astype(int)

# Last name (assume last word)
df["LastName"] = df["Name"].str.split().str[-1]

# Fill missing categoricals with "Unknown"
for col in ["HomePlanet", "CryoSleep", "Destination", "VIP", "Deck", "Side"]:
    df[col] = df[col].fillna("Unknown").astype(str)

# Fill missing spending columns using median from the training part
spend_cols = ["RoomService", "FoodCourt", "ShoppingMall", "Spa", "VRDeck"]
train_idx = df["is_train"] == 1
for c in spend_cols + ["Age", "Num"]:
    med = df.loc[train_idx, c].median()
    df[c + "_missing"] = df[c].isna().astype(int)
    df[c] = df[c].fillna(med)

# Total expenditure
df["TotalSpend"] = df[spend_cols].sum(axis=1)

# Group size
group_size = df.groupby("GroupId")["PassengerId"].transform("count")
df["GroupSize"] = group_size

# Last name frequency (using the combined set)
last_name_freq = df.groupby("LastName")["PassengerId"].transform("count")
df["LastNameFreq"] = last_name_freq

# Categorical encoding: factorize on the combined set (safe, no label leakage)
cat_cols = ["HomePlanet", "CryoSleep", "Destination", "VIP", "Deck", "Side"]
for col in cat_cols:
    df[col], _ = pd.factorize(df[col])

# Features to keep (no strings, no IDs)
feature_cols = [
    "Age",
    "Age_missing",
    "RoomService",
    "RoomService_missing",
    "FoodCourt",
    "FoodCourt_missing",
    "ShoppingMall",
    "ShoppingMall_missing",
    "Spa",
    "Spa_missing",
    "VRDeck",
    "VRDeck_missing",
    "TotalSpend",
    "Num",
    "Num_missing",
    "HasCabin",
    "GroupSize",
    "LastNameFreq",
] + cat_cols

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Split back into train / test
# -------------------------------------------------------------
train_df = df[df["is_train"] == 1].reset_index(drop=True)
test_df = df[df["is_train"] == 0].reset_index(drop=True)

X = train_df[feature_cols].astype(np.float32)
y = train_df["Transported"].astype(int).values

X_test = test_df[feature_cols].astype(np.float32)
test_ids = test_df["PassengerId"].values

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Cross-validation setup
# -------------------------------------------------------------
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

# We will store OOF predictions and test predictions for each model
lgb_oof = np.zeros(len(X))
nn_oof = np.zeros(len(X))
lgb_test_preds = np.zeros(len(X_test))
nn_test_preds = np.zeros(len(X_test))

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. LightGBM parameters
# -------------------------------------------------------------
lgb_params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "binary_logloss",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "max_depth": -1,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "lambda_l1": 0.1,
    "lambda_l2": 0.1,
    "random_state": 42,
    "n_estimators": 2000,
    "verbose": -1,
}


# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. PyTorch neural network definition
# -------------------------------------------------------------
class MLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(128, 64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(32, 1),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


def train_mlp(
    model, train_loader, val_loader, epochs=200, patience=10, lr=1e-3, wd=1e-4
):
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    model.to(device)
    criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()
    optimizer = AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=lr, weight_decay=wd)
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
        optimizer, mode="min", factor=0.5, patience=5  # removed 'verbose'
    )
    best_val_loss = float("inf")
    early_stop_count = 0
    best_state = None

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for bx, by in train_loader:
            bx, by = bx.to(device), by.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            logits = model(bx).squeeze(1)
            loss = criterion(logits, by)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()

        # Validation
        model.eval()
        val_loss = 0.0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for bx, by in val_loader:
                bx, by = bx.to(device), by.to(device)
                logits = model(bx).squeeze(1)
                loss = criterion(logits, by)
                val_loss += loss.item() * len(by)
        val_loss /= len(val_loader.dataset)

        scheduler.step(val_loss)

        if val_loss < best_val_loss:
            best_val_loss = val_loss
            best_state = model.state_dict()
            early_stop_count = 0
        else:
            early_stop_count += 1
            if early_stop_count >= patience:
                break

    if best_state is not None:
        model.load_state_dict(best_state)
    return model


def predict_mlp(model, loader):
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    model.to(device)
    model.eval()
    preds = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for bx, _ in loader:  # loader yields (inputs, labels) or (inputs, dummy)
            bx = bx.to(device)
            logits = model(bx).squeeze(1)
            prob = torch.sigmoid(logits).cpu().numpy()
            preds.append(prob)
    return np.concatenate(preds)


# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. 5‑fold cross‑validation
# -------------------------------------------------------------
for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
    print(f"=== Fold {fold+1}/5 ===", flush=True)

    X_tr, X_val = X.iloc[train_idx].values, X.iloc[val_idx].values
    y_tr, y_val = y[train_idx], y[val_idx]

    # --- LightGBM ---
    model_lgb = LGBMClassifier(**lgb_params)
    model_lgb.fit(
        X_tr,
        y_tr,
        eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
        eval_metric="binary_logloss",
        callbacks=[early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50)],
    )
    lgb_oof[val_idx] = model_lgb.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    lgb_test_preds += model_lgb.predict_proba(X_test.values)[:, 1] / skf.n_splits

    # --- Neural Network ---
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_tr_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_tr)
    X_val_scaled = scaler.transform(X_val)

    # Create DataLoaders
    batch_size = 256
    train_ds = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(X_tr_scaled, dtype=torch.float32),
        torch.tensor(y_tr, dtype=torch.float32),
    )
    val_ds = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(X_val_scaled, dtype=torch.float32),
        torch.tensor(y_val, dtype=torch.float32),
    )
    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False)

    mlp_model = MLP(input_dim=X.shape[1])
    mlp_model = train_mlp(
        mlp_model, train_loader, val_loader, epochs=200, patience=10, lr=5e-4, wd=1e-4
    )

    nn_oof[val_idx] = predict_mlp(mlp_model, val_loader)

    # Predict on test data for this fold
    # --- FIX: add dummy labels to test TensorDataset so the loader yields (inputs, labels) ---
    X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test.values)
    test_ds = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(X_test_scaled, dtype=torch.float32),
        torch.zeros(len(X_test_scaled), dtype=torch.float32),  # dummy labels
    )
    test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False)
    nn_test_preds += predict_mlp(mlp_model, test_loader) / skf.n_splits

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Ensemble OOF predictions and compute final validation score
# -------------------------------------------------------------
blend_oof = (lgb_oof + nn_oof) / 2.0
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y, blend_oof > 0.5)
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Final test predictions and submission
# -------------------------------------------------------------
blend_test = (lgb_test_preds + nn_test_preds) / 2.0
test_pred_bool = blend_test > 0.5
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"PassengerId": test_ids, "Transported": np.where(test_pred_bool, "True", "False")}
)
submission.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission.csv", flush=True)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

import xgboost as xgb
from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingClassifier
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ----------------------------- load data ---------------------------------
train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("data/sample_submission.csv")

# save passenger ids for submission
test_ids = test["PassengerId"].copy()

# add indicator for train/test
train["is_train"] = 1
test["is_train"] = 0
test["Transported"] = np.nan
combined = pd.concat([train, test], ignore_index=True)

# ------------------------- feature engineering ---------------------------
# PassengerId -> group id, passenger number, group size
combined[["GroupId", "PassengerNum"]] = combined["PassengerId"].str.split(
    "_", expand=True
)
combined["PassengerNum"] = combined["PassengerNum"].astype(int)
group_sizes = combined.groupby("GroupId")["PassengerId"].transform("count")
combined["GroupSize"] = group_sizes

# Cabin -> deck, cabin number, side
combined[["Deck", "CabinNum", "Side"]] = combined["Cabin"].str.split("/", expand=True)
combined["Deck"] = combined["Deck"].fillna("Unknown")
combined["Side"] = combined["Side"].fillna("Unknown")
combined["CabinNum"] = pd.to_numeric(combined["CabinNum"], errors="coerce")

# fill missing booleans with majority class (False)
combined["CryoSleep"] = combined["CryoSleep"].fillna("False")
combined["VIP"] = combined["VIP"].fillna("False")

# fill categorical NaNs
for col in ["HomePlanet", "Destination"]:
    combined[col] = combined[col].fillna("Unknown")

# total spending
spending_cols = ["RoomService", "FoodCourt", "ShoppingMall", "Spa", "VRDeck"]
combined["TotalSpending"] = combined[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)

# impute numeric missing values with median
numeric_cols = [
    "Age",
    "CabinNum",
    "RoomService",
    "FoodCourt",
    "ShoppingMall",
    "Spa",
    "VRDeck",
    "TotalSpending",
]
for col in numeric_cols:
    combined[col] = combined[col].fillna(combined[col].median())

# drop original columns we won’t use as features
combined.drop(columns=["PassengerId", "Name", "Cabin", "GroupId"], inplace=True)

# factorize categorical columns (they are now filled, no NaN)
categorical_cols = ["HomePlanet", "Destination", "Deck", "Side", "CryoSleep", "VIP"]
for col in categorical_cols:
    combined[col], _ = pd.factorize(combined[col])

# separate back
train_df = combined[combined["is_train"] == 1].drop(columns=["is_train", "Transported"])
test_df = combined[combined["is_train"] == 0].drop(columns=["is_train", "Transported"])
y = train[train["is_train"] == 1]["Transported"].astype(int).values

features = train_df.columns.tolist()
cat_features_idx = [features.index(col) for col in categorical_cols]

# features for MLP (numeric only will be scaled, categoricals one‑hot encoded)
mlp_numeric_features = [col for col in features if col not in categorical_cols]
mlp_categorical_features = categorical_cols

# -------------------------- stacking setup -------------------------------
n_splits = 5
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

n_train = len(train_df)
n_test = len(test_df)
n_base = 4  # LGBM, XGBoost, HGB, MLP
oof_preds = np.zeros((n_train, n_base))
test_preds = np.zeros((n_test, n_base))

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

for fold, (tr_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(train_df, y)):
    X_tr, y_tr = train_df.iloc[tr_idx], y[tr_idx]
    X_val, y_val = train_df.iloc[val_idx], y[val_idx]
    X_test = test_df.copy()

    # ---------- 1. LightGBM ----------
    lgb_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        n_estimators=200,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        max_depth=6,
        num_leaves=31,
        random_state=42,
        verbose=-1,
        categorical_feature=cat_features_idx,
    )
    lgb_model.fit(
        X_tr,
        y_tr,
        eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
        eval_metric="accuracy",
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
    )
    oof_preds[val_idx, 0] = lgb_model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]

    # ---------- 2. XGBoost ----------

    X_val_xgb = X_val.copy()
    X_test_xgb = X_test.copy()
    for col in categorical_cols:
        X_tr_xgb[col] = X_tr_xgb[col].astype("category")
        X_val_xgb[col] = X_val_xgb[col].astype("category")
        X_test_xgb[col] = X_test_xgb[col].astype("category")
    xgb_model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
        n_estimators=200,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        max_depth=6,
        random_state=42,
        enable_categorical=True,
        verbosity=0,
        early_stopping_rounds=50,  # moved from .fit() to constructor
    )
    xgb_model.fit(
        X_tr_xgb,
        y_tr,
        eval_set=[(X_val_xgb, y_val)],
        verbose=False,
    )
    oof_preds[val_idx, 1] = xgb_model.predict_proba(X_val_xgb)[:, 1]
    test_preds[:, 1] += xgb_model.predict_proba(X_test_xgb)[:, 1]

    # ---------- 3. HistGradientBoosting ----------
    hgb_model = HistGradientBoostingClassifier(
        max_iter=200,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        max_depth=6,
        random_state=42,
        categorical_features=cat_features_idx,
    )
    hgb_model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
    oof_preds[val_idx, 2] = hgb_model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    test_preds[:, 2] += hgb_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

    # ---------- 4. MLP ----------
    # preprocessing for MLP: scale numeric, one‑hot encode categoricals
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    ohe = OneHotEncoder(sparse_output=False, handle_unknown="ignore")
    X_tr_num = scaler.fit_transform(X_tr[mlp_numeric_features])
    X_tr_cat = ohe.fit_transform(X_tr[mlp_categorical_features])
    X_tr_mlp = np.hstack([X_tr_num, X_tr_cat])
    X_val_num = scaler.transform(X_val[mlp_numeric_features])
    X_val_cat = ohe.transform(X_val[mlp_categorical_features])
    X_val_mlp = np.hstack([X_val_num, X_val_cat])
    X_test_num = scaler.transform(X_test[mlp_numeric_features])
    X_test_cat = ohe.transform(X_test[mlp_categorical_features])
    X_test_mlp = np.hstack([X_test_num, X_test_cat])

    input_dim = X_tr_mlp.shape[1]
    mlp = nn.Sequential(
        nn.Linear(input_dim, 64),
        nn.ReLU(),
        nn.Dropout(0.3),
        nn.Linear(64, 32),
        nn.ReLU(),
        nn.Dropout(0.3),
        nn.Linear(32, 1),
        nn.Sigmoid(),
    ).to(device)

    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(mlp.parameters(), lr=0.001)
    criterion = nn.BCELoss()

    train_ds = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(X_tr_mlp, dtype=torch.float32),
        torch.tensor(y_tr, dtype=torch.float32).view(-1, 1),
    )
    val_ds = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(X_val_mlp, dtype=torch.float32),
        torch.tensor(y_val, dtype=torch.float32).view(-1, 1),
    )
    test_ds = TensorDataset(torch.tensor(X_test_mlp, dtype=torch.float32))
    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=256, shuffle=True)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=1024)
    test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=1024)

    best_loss = float("inf")
    best_state = None
    patience = 10
    patience_cnt = 0
    for epoch in range(50):
        mlp.train()
        for bx, by in train_loader:
            bx, by = bx.to(device), by.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss = criterion(mlp(bx), by)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
        mlp.eval()
        val_loss = 0.0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for bx, by in val_loader:
                bx, by = bx.to(device), by.to(device)
                loss = criterion(mlp(bx), by)
                val_loss += loss.item() * len(bx)
        val_loss /= len(val_ds)
        if val_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_loss
            best_state = mlp.state_dict()
            patience_cnt = 0
        else:
            patience_cnt += 1
            if patience_cnt >= patience:
                break
    mlp.load_state_dict(best_state)
    mlp.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        val_tensor = torch.tensor(X_val_mlp, dtype=torch.float32).to(device)
        oof_preds[val_idx, 3] = mlp(val_tensor).cpu().numpy().ravel()
        test_tensor = torch.tensor(X_test_mlp, dtype=torch.float32).to(device)
        test_preds[:, 3] += mlp(test_tensor).cpu().numpy().ravel()

# average test predictions across folds
test_preds /= n_splits

# ---------------------- meta‑learner (logistic regression) ---------------
meta_model = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, random_state=42)
meta_model.fit(oof_preds, y)
meta_oof = meta_model.predict(oof_preds)
cv_score = accuracy_score(y, meta_oof)

# ---------------------- test submission ---------------------------------
test_meta = meta_model.predict(test_preds)
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"PassengerId": test_ids, "Transported": test_meta.astype(bool)}
)
submission.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

# ---------------------- final output ------------------------------------
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {cv_score}")

import warnings

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import random
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, train_test_split

import lightgbm as lgb

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load data
# ------------------------------------------------------------
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Compute global GroupSize (no target leakage)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
all_ids = pd.concat([train[["PassengerId"]], test[["PassengerId"]]], axis=0)
all_ids["GroupId"] = all_ids["PassengerId"].str.split("_").str[0]
group_size_map = all_ids["GroupId"].value_counts().to_dict()


def add_group_size(df):
    df = df.copy()
    df["GroupSize"] = df["PassengerId"].str.split("_").str[0].map(group_size_map)
    df["GroupSize"] = df["GroupSize"].fillna(1).astype(int)
    return df


train = add_group_size(train)
test = add_group_size(test)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Feature engineering (same as original plan)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
def engineer_features(df):
    df = df.copy()

    # GroupId (optional, but kept as categorical)
    df["GroupId"] = df["PassengerId"].str.split("_").str[0]

    # Cabin -> deck, number, side
    def split_cabin(c):
        if isinstance(c, str):
            parts = c.split("/")
            if len(parts) == 3:
                deck = parts[0]
                try:
                    num = int(parts[1])
                except:
                    num = np.nan
                side = parts[2]
                return deck, num, side
        return np.nan, np.nan, np.nan

    decks, nums, sides = zip(*df["Cabin"].apply(split_cabin))
    df["Deck"] = decks
    df["CabinNum"] = nums
    df["Side"] = sides

    # Spending features
    spend_cols = ["RoomService", "FoodCourt", "ShoppingMall", "Spa", "VRDeck"]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Spaceship Titanic – improved solution with target-encoding of high‑cardinality
categoricals (GroupId, LastName) via 5‑fold out‑of‑fold, missing indicators,
interaction features, and Optuna‑tuned LightGBM.
Fixed: convert categorical features to pandas 'category' dtype (not 'object')
so LightGBM accepts them.
"""

import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, train_test_split
import optuna
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ======================== 1. Load data ========================
train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")

# Keep PassengerId for submission
test_ids = test["PassengerId"].copy()

# Separate target
y = train["Transported"].map({"True": 1, "False": 0}).values.astype(int)
train.drop("Transported", axis=1, inplace=True)

# Combine for consistent preprocessing
train["_is_train"] = 1
test["_is_train"] = 0
combined = pd.concat([train, test], ignore_index=True)

# ======================== 2. Feature engineering ========================
# PassengerId
combined[["GroupId", "PassengerNum"]] = combined["PassengerId"].str.split(
    "_", expand=True
)
combined["PassengerNum"] = combined["PassengerNum"].astype(float)

# Cabin
cabin_split = combined["Cabin"].str.split("/", n=2, expand=True)
cabin_split.columns = ["Deck", "CabinNum", "Side"]
cabin_split["CabinNum"] = pd.to_numeric(cabin_split["CabinNum"], errors="coerce")
combined["Deck"] = cabin_split["Deck"]
combined["CabinNum"] = cabin_split["CabinNum"]
combined["Side"] = cabin_split["Side"]

# Name -> LastName
combined["LastName"] = combined["Name"].str.split().str[-1]

# ---------- 2a. Missing indicators ----------
missing_cols = [
    "Age",
    "RoomService",
    "FoodCourt",
    "ShoppingMall",
    "Spa",
    "VRDeck",
    "CryoSleep",
    "VIP",
    "HomePlanet",
    "Destination",
    "Deck",
    "Side",
    "LastName",
]
for col in missing_cols:
    if col in combined.columns:
        combined[col + "_missing"] = combined[col].isna().astype(int)

# ---------- 2b. Imputation ----------
# Numeric columns (including PassengerNum, CabinNum)
num_cols = [
    "Age",
    "RoomService",
    "FoodCourt",
    "ShoppingMall",
    "Spa",
    "VRDeck",
    "PassengerNum",
    "CabinNum",
]
for c in num_cols:
    med = combined[c].median()
    combined[c] = combined[c].fillna(med)

# Boolean / categorical columns
for bool_col in ["CryoSleep", "VIP"]:
    combined[bool_col] = (
        combined[bool_col]
        .replace({True: 1, False: 0, "True": 1, "False": 0})
        .astype(float)
    )
    modes = combined[bool_col].mode()
    fill_val = modes.iloc[0] if len(modes) > 0 else 0
    combined[bool_col] = combined[bool_col].fillna(fill_val).astype(int)

# Other categorical columns
cat_cols_other = ["HomePlanet", "Destination", "Deck", "Side", "LastName", "GroupId"]
for c in cat_cols_other:
    combined[c] = combined[c].astype(str).str.strip()
    combined[c] = combined[c].replace(["", "nan", "None"], "Unknown")
    combined[c] = combined[c].fillna("Unknown")

# ---------- 2c. Interaction features ----------
amenities = ["RoomService", "FoodCourt", "ShoppingMall", "Spa", "VRDeck"]
for col in amenities:
    combined["VIP_" + col] = combined["VIP"] * combined[col]
    combined["Cryo_" + col] = combined["CryoSleep"] * combined[col]

# Drop raw columns
combined.drop(columns=["PassengerId", "Name", "Cabin"], inplace=True)

# ---------- 2d. Group-level aggregations ----------
agg_cols = [
    "Age",
    "RoomService",
    "FoodCourt",
    "ShoppingMall",
    "Spa",
    "VRDeck",
    "PassengerNum",
    "VIP",
    "CryoSleep",
]
# Compute on combined (no target leakage because only passenger attributes are used)
group_stats = (
    combined.groupby("GroupId")[agg_cols]
    .agg(["mean", "std", "min", "max"])
    .reset_index()
)
group_stats.columns = ["GroupId"] + [
    f"Grp_{col}_{stat}" for col in agg_cols for stat in ["mean", "std", "min", "max"]
]
group_size = combined.groupby("GroupId").size().reset_index(name="Grp_Size")
group_stats = group_stats.merge(group_size, on="GroupId", how="left")

combined = combined.merge(group_stats, on="GroupId", how="left")

# ---------- 2e. Split back ----------
train_processed = combined[combined["_is_train"] == 1].drop(columns=["_is_train"])
test_processed = combined[combined["_is_train"] == 0].drop(columns=["_is_train"])

# ======================== 3. Define categorical feature list (for LightGBM) ========================
cat_features_base = [
    "HomePlanet",
    "Destination",
    "Deck",
    "Side",
    "GroupId",
    "LastName",
]

# ***** FIX: convert to category dtype, NOT object/string *****
for c in cat_features_base:
    train_processed[c] = train_processed[c].astype("category")
    test_processed[c] = test_processed[c].astype("category")


# ======================== 4. Target encoding helper ========================
def add_target_encoding(train_df, test_df, y, encode_cols, n_folds=5, random_state=42):
    """
    Compute out‑of‑fold target encoding for train and global mean encoding for test.
    Returns modified copies (the originals are changed in‑place).
    """
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_folds, shuffle=True, random_state=random_state)
    prior = y.mean()

    # Initialise encoded columns
    for col in encode_cols:
        train_df[col + "_te"] = np.nan
        test_df[col + "_te"] = 0.0

    # Global encoding (for test) – per category mean on full train
    global_enc = {}
    for col in encode_cols:
        # .astype(str) works on category dtype and returns object, safe for .groupby
        cat_means = (
            pd.Series(y, index=train_df[col].astype(str))
            .groupby(train_df[col].astype(str))
            .mean()
        )
        global_enc[col] = cat_means

    # Out‑of‑fold encoding for train
    for fold_idx, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(train_df, y)):
        for col in encode_cols:
            train_fold = train_df.iloc[train_idx][col].astype(str)
            y_fold = y[train_idx]
            cat_means_fold = (
                pd.Series(y_fold, index=train_fold).groupby(train_fold).mean()
            )
            val_series = train_df.iloc[val_idx][col].astype(str)
            train_df.loc[train_df.index[val_idx], col + "_te"] = val_series.map(
                cat_means_fold
            )

    # Fill any remaining NaN with the overall prior
    for col in encode_cols:
        train_df[col + "_te"] = train_df[col + "_te"].fillna(prior)
        # For test: map with global encoding and fallback to prior
        test_df[col + "_te"] = (
            test_df[col].astype(str).map(global_enc[col]).fillna(prior)
        )

    return train_df, test_df


# ======================== 5. Prepare base features (without target encoding) ========================
X_base_train = train_processed.copy()
X_base_test = test_processed.copy()

# We will later add target-encoded columns inside the CV loop.
target_encode_cols = ["GroupId", "LastName"]


# ======================== 6. Optuna hyperparameter tuning ========================
def objective(trial):
    params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "binary_error",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",

        "lambda_l1": trial.suggest_float("lambda_l1", 1e-8, 10.0, log=True),
        "lambda_l2": trial.suggest_float("lambda_l2", 1e-8, 10.0, log=True),
    }

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    fold_accs = []

    for train_idx, val_idx in skf.split(X_base_train, y):
        X_tr = X_base_train.iloc[train_idx].copy()
        y_tr = y[train_idx]
        X_val = X_base_train.iloc[val_idx].copy()
        y_val = y[val_idx]

        # Target encoding using ONLY the training fold
        prior = y_tr.mean()
        for col in target_encode_cols:
            cat_means = (
                pd.Series(y_tr, index=X_tr[col].astype(str))
                .groupby(X_tr[col].astype(str))
                .mean()
            )
            X_tr[col + "_te"] = X_tr[col].astype(str).map(cat_means).fillna(prior)
            X_val[col + "_te"] = X_val[col].astype(str).map(cat_means).fillna(prior)

        # categorical columns are already 'category' dtype – LightGBM will use them
        dtrain = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr, categorical_feature=cat_features_base)
        dval = lgb.Dataset(
            X_val,
            label=y_val,
            categorical_feature=cat_features_base,
            reference=dtrain,
        )
        model = lgb.train(
            params,
            dtrain,
            num_boost_round=1000,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            valid_names=["val"],
            callbacks=[
                lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False),
                lgb.log_evaluation(0),
            ],
        )
        preds = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
        acc = ((preds >= 0.5).astype(int) == y_val).mean()
        fold_accs.append(acc)

    return np.mean(fold_accs)


study = optuna.create_study(
    direction="maximize",
    sampler=optuna.samplers.TPESampler(seed=42),
)
study.optimize(objective, n_trials=30, timeout=600)  # shorter search for speed

best_params = study.best_params
best_params.update(

        "metric": "binary_error",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "verbosity": -1,

)

cv_scores = []

for train_idx, val_idx in skf.split(X_base_train, y):

    for col in target_encode_cols:

    dval = lgb.Dataset(
        X_val,
        label=y_val,
        categorical_feature=cat_features_base,
        reference=dtrain,
    )
    model = lgb.train(
        best_params,
        dtrain,
        num_boost_round=1000,
        valid_sets=[dval],
        valid_names=["val"],
        callbacks=[
            lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False),

        ],
    )
    preds = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
    acc = ((preds >= 0.5).astype(int) == y_val).mean()
    cv_scores.append(acc)

final_cv_accuracy = np.mean(cv_scores)

# ======================== 8. Final model on full training data ========================
# (a) Add out‑of‑fold target encoding on the whole training set and global encoding on test
X_train_final = X_base_train.copy()
X_test_final = X_base_test.copy()
add_target_encoding(

)

# (b) Create a small validation set for early stopping during final training
